benchmark_method.fixture: A unit-height selected-width rectangle is offset outward by exactly 1/20 with selected-field round corners. Its exact translation by (1/20, 1/40) is intersected with the original; that exact result is then Booleaned against one further identical translation.
benchmark_method.timing_scope: The authored region, offsets, translations, and first Boolean are outside each timed loop. The timed operation is the later evidence query, one exact intersection region, or one exact all-four batch.
benchmark_method.perf_command: taskset -c 11 perf stat -e instructions,cycles,task-clock,page-faults env HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_SAMPLES=1 HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_ITERS=5 HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_GROUP=algebraic_round_boolean/correlated_endpoint_reentry HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_IMPL=hypercurve_exact_all_four <comparative-executable>
benchmark_method.perf_normalization: Subtract the matched disabled process, whose fixture includes one untimed all-four batch, then divide by five timed batches.
benchmark_method.heap_method: Heaptrack records one timed all-four batch. Subtract the matched disabled process to remove fixture construction and its one untimed batch.
